signing.windows: Unsigned; publisher signing has not been configured
signing.macos: Ad hoc build signature; no Developer ID signing or notarization
signing.linux: Archive SHA-256 checksums; no detached publisher signature

release_features: Convert the embedded data of a JavaScript shell page instead of refusing it: title, description, JSON-LD text and noscript text from the static HTML, when the body text reaches 200 characters. The capture is partial, snapshot kind embedded_data, with one javascript_required error. This reads pages such as an Airbnb listing, a SoundCloud track or a Bluesky profile; crates.io still refuses.
Name AWS WAF challenge pages as challenge aws-waf, such as IMDb or Binance pages answered with HTTP 202, instead of refusing them as javascript_required.
release_fixes: Verify --url TLS with the operating system trust store through truststore 0.10.5, so pages whose root is only in that store, such as GlobalSign Root R46 on macOS, load instead of refusing at tls. The macOS and Windows verifiers may fetch missing intermediates themselves.

features: Offline PDF, DOCX, PPTX, workbook and static HTML conversion
EPUB 2/3 conversion with Unicode and publication navigation
Explicit URL acquisition and optional isolated JavaScript capture
